question: start
name: Specific return or corpus expectations
definition: Starts with a concrete expectation of returns or a target corpus (e.g. a % return, '1 crore in 10 years', 'become rich'), including expectations set by ads or creators.
include: Stated % returns, crore targets, 'make us rich', expectations from videos/ads.
exclude: General long-term or compounding motives without a number (use start_long_horizon_compounding).

question: start
name: Family and future security
definition: Starts a SIP to secure family, children or old age, or to build a saving habit.
include: Family's future, children, next generation, old-age support, saving money, safety.

question: start
name: Long horizon / compounding belief
definition: Starts believing in long holding periods and compounding, often with a multi-decade horizon.
include: 20-40 year horizons, compounding, 'small amounts grow', tax-saving long-term plans.

question: start
name: Started on someone else's advice
definition: SIP was started through an agent, bank RM, distributor or 'manager', often in regular plans without full understanding.
include: Agents, bank reps, fund managers/advisers, started regular plan unknowingly.

question: start
name: Beginner / first SIP
definition: Writer is a first-time or new investor starting their first SIP (young, late, or just beginning).
include: First SIP, beginner, just started, age-based starting.

question: start
name: Friction when setting up a SIP
definition: Problems or confusion during SIP setup: minimum amounts, tenure options, SIP not activating, checking exit options first.
include: Minimum amount surprises, tenure limits, SIP not starting, asking how to stop before starting.
exclude: Problems after the SIP is running (use stop_* themes).

question: behaviour
name: Steady continuing
definition: Writer has kept SIPs going for months or years with no major issues.
include: Years of continuing, steady accumulation, easy ongoing management.

question: behaviour
name: Set and forget / check rarely
definition: Deliberately stops checking or checks returns only after years.
include: Automated SIPs, not visiting the app, 'check after 5 years'.

question: behaviour
name: Watching returns: flat, negative or disappointing
definition: Writer tracks returns in the months/years after starting and reports flat, negative or disappointing results, or feeling misled.
include: Being at a loss, zero returns after N years, comparing to index levels, feeling misled about returns.

question: behaviour
name: Holding through losses or falls
definition: Keeps investing despite losses or market falls, often reassured by experience or education.
include: 'Will not stop', continuing despite loss, SIP beat own picking, reassurance from content.

question: behaviour
name: Increasing / step-up
definition: Wants to or does increase the SIP amount or use step-up.
include: Step-up, top-up, increase amount after N years.
exclude: Being unable to modify (code that under stop_missing_controls too if it leads to stopping).

question: behaviour
name: Wanting to pause, skip or reduce
definition: Considers pausing, skipping a month, reducing or restarting lower rather than cancelling.
include: Skip this month, pause vs exit, restart with lower amount, pause not cancel.

question: behaviour
name: Market-timing urges
definition: Tries or plans to time instalments to market levels (pause at highs, invest at dips).
include: Pausing at highs, executing early on dips, waiting for a dip.

question: behaviour
name: Switching / restructuring holdings
definition: Switches platform or plan, restarts in another mode, trims funds, or times cancellation around exit load.
include: Platform switches, regular to direct, restarting mode, too many funds, exit-load timing.

question: behaviour
name: Manual workarounds and forgetting
definition: Has to pay or act manually each month (or deactivate SIPs), and sometimes forgets and skips.
include: Manual payment, weekly deactivation, changing bank for autopay, forgetting manual buys.

question: behaviour
name: Other behaviour
definition: Behaviour codes that fit no other theme.
include: Lock-in completed and redeeming.

question: stop
name: Autopay / mandate / payment failure
definition: SIP instalments miss or fail because of autopay, mandate, bank or funding problems, or lack of auto-debit.
include: Autopay fails, mandate not arriving, orders rejected, bank blocked, manual top-up burden, multiple debits.

question: stop
name: Stopped or changed by platform or fund
definition: SIP was paused, deleted, cancelled or changed by the fund house or platform, not by the investor.
include: Fund suspensions, SIPs deleted after rule changes, platform reducing SIP or forcing switches, fear of such breaks.

question: stop
name: Missing pause / edit / reduce controls
definition: Investor wants to pause, skip, edit or reduce but the option does not exist or is hard, so they cancel or consider it.
include: No pause/edit button, cannot reduce amount, skip bug, physical letter to pause, missing SIP options.

question: stop
name: App reliability and execution errors
definition: SIP orders execute wrongly or slowly, or holdings show incorrectly.
include: Holiday executions, multiple executions, slow processing, missing instalments in holdings.

question: stop
name: Confusion about money after cancelling
definition: After cancelling, investor is confused or anxious about where the money went, refunds or ongoing autopay.
include: Money not returned, cancelled SIP vanished, autopay still showing, deduction after cancel.

question: stop
name: Early or accidental cancellation
definition: Cancels within days of starting or by mistake, often from confusion about how SIP instalments work.
include: Same-day cancel, accidental cancel, confused about next instalment date.
exclude: Cancellation for returns or cash reasons.

question: stop
name: Poor, flat or negative returns
definition: Stops or considers stopping because returns are low, flat or negative over months/years, or believes SIPs underperform.
include: Not performing, no returns for years, loss, prefers DIY strategy over SIP.

question: stop
name: Market fall / panic
definition: Stops or considers stopping in a falling market, or describes investors panicking.
include: Market fall, panic, buy high sell low, thinking of stopping during falls.
exclude: Long-run underperformance without a fall (use stop_poor_returns).

question: stop
name: Cash need / affordability
definition: Stops, pauses or withdraws because money is needed elsewhere or the amount becomes hard to sustain.
include: Compulsion to withdraw, no funds for months, house purchase, step-up hard to sustain.

question: stop
name: Switching plan, fund or platform (not a real drop)
definition: Stops a SIP only to restart elsewhere: regular to direct, another fund, or another platform.
include: Regular to direct, better fund, leaving the platform for another.

question: stop
name: Trust and support breakdown
definition: Stops or leaves after unresolved support issues, unresponsive agents or loss of trust.
include: Unresponsive support/agent, money disputes, 'can't trust', not knowing how to stop an agent SIP.
exclude: Pure technical failures without trust language.

question: stop
name: Other stop reasons
definition: Stop codes that fit no other theme, including stops with no stated reason.
include: Lock-in completed, stopped with no reason given.
